items.title: Lumma Stealer Uses Browser Fingerprinting to Collect Data and for Stealthy C&C Server Communications
items.description: Lumma Stealer has emerged as a serious threat in the cybercrime world, targeting users through fake software updates and cracked applications. This information-stealing malware targets the collection on login details, payment card information, and cryptocurrency wallet data from infected systems. items.title: Critical FortiWeb WAF Flaw Exploited in the Wild, Enabling Full Admin Takeover
items.description: Fortinet has issued an urgent advisory warning of a critical vulnerability in its FortiWeb web application firewall (WAF) product, which attackers are actively exploiting in the wild.
